description: HTTP header names and prefixes that Ferrum Edge owns: gateway assertions to backends, gateway diagnostic response headers, internal markers, mesh control headers, and admin API headers. Names are case-insensitive; prefixes match names case-insensitively. Entries with availability "v0.9.9" shipped in Ferrum Edge v0.9.9.

headers.name: x-consumer-
headers.edge_behavior: Gateway-owned consumer assertion namespace. Matching is ASCII case-insensitive and treats _ as equivalent to -. The gateway may emit only its authenticated identity values beneath this prefix; backend boundaries reject client or plugin values across the whole prefix, and it is forbidden in request and response trailers.

headers.name: X-Gateway-Error
headers.edge_behavior: Gateway-owned diagnostic response header. Every dispatch path strips a backend copy, in headers or trailers, before the gateway writes its own value. Values are the closed vocabulary in vocabularies/gateway-errors.json. Not authenticated.
